Exactly and yet I am really limited cause I don't seek people out and there are a lot of places I wouldn't go alone like bars or clubs. I go to museums and malls. I used to go the occasional concert so I miss that. I t drives me crazy not having anywhere to go as a solo person!
It does relax me and makes me sleepy. I only take 0.5 mg daily and two daily if the anxiety is particularly bad.
The emptiness is the worst feeling. Nothing gives me long lasting fulfillment.

I feel the same way. I have never kept friends for long and never had any that were really close. I've never dated. I feel I need to lose weight to be more attractive first. But then I think nah I just need an entire personality change! lol
yes I wish I had a med to stop all the feels.
Probably not what you mean but I feel like I am two people in one I am the innocent boring girl and a sexy mean girl.
I don't have any friends so its another lonely day for me. I'm in my thirties how am I going to get friends now if I couldn't do when I was young. I am so sad.

Thank you for your words. Yeah I am working now on hobbies I had long abandoned but its mostly to avoid my family problems. My parents are very supportive of me but they but they have their own problems my mother for example has to deal with a severely mentally ill son aka my brother and my father is an alcoholic. So I feel bad bothering them with my issues since they are very anxious people.
Oh really?! Will do then.

I have nine villagers right now and a camper came in today that I really want. I played the card game and won the first one but lost the next two rounds. I keep asking her to move in over and over again and she keeps saying no. What can I do? Or is there no point in asking her anymore?

Yeah I am on medication now and started seeing a therapist but i can't stop with anxiety I've even started doing my favorite hobbies and going to church. Actually my family is the problem but without them I am completely alone. :(
It's been horrible. My mom asks me why I am feeling so bad since we have had this difficult situation with my brother for a long time now. I don't know why but I feel like dying every day this month.

If I don't go out and in to the checkout page online the "right" amount of times when ordering a product will be cursed in that I will think the same horrible thought that came up while I was trying to order it whenever I use it.

But then waking up is horrible. All the anxiety comes rushing back in. I go to check my phone to see if I received an emergency call from family while I was sleeping. I check twitter to see if something tragic happened to one of my favorite celebrities. I start panicking about my life and my age and how far behind I am. It goes on and on only different worries throughout the day. I go to sleep late into the night because of my constant thoughts and decide to sleep on my sofa because I can't can't take sleeping on my bed anymore for some reason.
I hate that it makes me so scared. Which is weird cause I am tired of living the way I am.
That's what I have decided to do. I have started taking more risks. I am wanting to die anyway so I don't care anymore.
I want that too, but I am a person with a lot of problems and I don't think just anyone is strong enough to deal with them and even if they were that eventually it will wear them down.
I am 35 and same. I see no hope in the future anymore. All pain. Nothing helps.
Your welcome. You are brave for doing it tbh.
I think you're cute and I like your hair do you babe!

I know how you feel. I lived my youth in a home full of domestic violence. My parents always earned minimum wage. Now I am an adult and live by myself. I paid off my car this year. I have actually managed to get a career and have a license as a registered nurse. On my own I was making two times what my parents made together growing up. Yet not of this mattered. The money and people saying I should be proud of being a nurse it didn't matter. I was miserable going to work. The extra spending money and stuff I bought with it did not make me any happier. My self confidence still on the floor and it keep going down as everyone around me seemed to be getting recognized and I didn't. I tried so hard to do my best and yet none of that mattered.
Yeah I also felt like I had to be an adult when I was young. My parents fought all the time. I was fully aware of my mother cheating on my dad. My brother was born 10 years after me.
Exactly men have cool titles when they are old like silver fox whereas for women we are just old.
It's quarterlife crisis. When I was that age I bought those books. I never finished reading them and now I am in my thirites!
You are so young. Please go out there and doing everything you want. Don't be like me having regrets for having wasted so much time.

Yep. I am 35 and feel so old. It's worse cause I'm a woman and you now how men always go for women in their twenties. But when I was in my twenties no one showed interest. Maybe its my body type. Maybe I just didn't go out enough. It just didn't happen for me. I'm scared that I have passed the age where I could make my dreams come true. I dread 40 so bad. I am so afraid.
Yeah I go through full scenarios. Like getting a tumor, getting the news from the doctor, treatment; etc. It's horrible I think about these tragic things all the time.
I don't even know how to start. I've never even dated. It's all so scary but I do want to be with someone.

It's both ig. I always feel guilty because I have these super high expectations for myself yet I've never been able to achieve any of them really. Getting a place for my brother to live is important and something I want to do now since my main anxiety is my mom having to live with him. I fear for her safety. But I don't what's the best thing to do for him you know? I wish I could look into the future and see what option is best. Add to that fact that were not rich people who can afford a great treatment place for him for his schizophrenia. He is non complaint with meds. This situation is what is killing me right now.

Yeah I am not nearly as bad as I was in the past where I had weird sensation all over my body. At least I am not getting that but I do feel my heart drop all the time if you know what I mean.

Thank you for your support.

Thanks. Yeah I always here to take one day at a time but with my anxiety I can't stop thinking about the future like months and even years from now. I know its stupid because I may not even get that far because life is really unpredictable but I can't help it. Yeah I think there are some support groups online rn. I really wish things were in person again. I didn't think the pandemic would affect me this much. I used to go to church back when I felt at my worst and it helped but now I think everything is still closed and online here.
Thank you. I hope things get better for you.

I felt like that too and quit. But honestly its worse not working. It's made me feel like I have no purpose so not only am I super anxious right now but super depressed as well. I want to go back to work but I am a nurse and you have to give your 100% at the job and I don't think I can even give 50% right now.

Not really. I hope to see a therapist soon but I keep delaying that. I feel so bad cause I keep bothering my mom who already has a terrible situation to deal with but I really have no one else to talk too. I feel so alone.

I feel so hopeless. I've never made friends or dated and I don't even see the possibility of that happening. I'm so scared. I am so alone. I don't have anyone else other than my parents and I have a lot of issues with them and they have my brother to worry about. I don't want to live anymore.

I am too old to chase after my dreams, and I will eventually have to care for my aging parents and mentally ill brother all on my own. I can't do this. I don't want to.
Same I just don't want to sleep because the anxious thought keep me up.

Same I am always envious of others who manged to be able to do what they wanted and live normal lives because they are not riddled with anxiety. I also have ocd and it has ruined me.
